subject: VALUE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB505). THE RULE IS NOW WRITTEN DOWN, AND ITS CONFORMING HALF COMPILES. Before this landing there was no test of what SR18 says: DataBinder.ValidateTableValues asked `item.Occurs is not null || item.IsDynamicTable` -- about THIS entry only -- and answered every other shape with one staged COBOL0899 ("recognized but currently supported only on a single-dimension table's own OCCURS entry"). So the rule's CONFORMING half, `01 T OCCURS 3. 05 X PIC X(2) VALUE "AB" FROM (1).`, which SR18 expressly permits ("...or be subordinate to a data description entry that contains an OCCURS clause"), was REFUSED as legal source, and its VIOLATING half was rejected as a compiler limitation rather than as the user's bug. Both halves now answer from OccursChainOf, the Parent walk that IS the rule: an empty chain is COBOL1944 naming SR18, a non-empty one is the dimension list SR20/SR21 key against. MEASURED: the conforming subordinate shape runs and seeds ([AB|CD|AB], golden line 1 at 2023 and 2002); the violation draws COBOL1944 at ALL FOUR editions (SR18 carries no version proviso; at 85 the format-2 introduction gate COBOL0900 is reported alongside it, not instead of it). The screen runs post-forest because Parent does not exist at entry bind -- BindEntries links the item into its parent AFTER BindEntry returns.
